sections.title: COLLECTION MODES & INSTRUMENT DETAILS  (repeating tender block - split payment across cash, cheque and IBFT supported)

fields.validation: Auto-generated, unique, gapless and immutable.
Date the money is received; must fall in an open accounting period.
Against invoice / Advance from customer / Security deposit / Refund received / Miscellaneous income. Drives which allocation fields are mandatory.
Receiving entity from sheet 01.
Gross amount received from the customer before any allocation.
Generated from the amount received.
fields.sampleEntry: Rupees five hundred sixty six thousand two hundred twenty only

fields.validation: Person who collected or recorded the receipt.

fields.field: Collected by (sales officer, if collected at site)
fields.validation: Field collections must be deposited within the timeframe set by policy.

fields.field: Deposit due date for field collections
fields.validation: Cash collected in the field must be banked within 24 hours; overdue deposits are flagged.

Draft / Issued (provisional) / Realised / Bounced / Cancelled / Reversed - with the effective date and reason. An issued receipt cannot be edited; cancellation or reversal requires an approved reversal entry recorded here, which reinstates the customer balance.
End-user customer / Distributor / Employee / Other party.
Pulled from the customer or distributor register.
NO MANUAL ENTRY. NTN and STRN pulled from the customer record selected in field 2.2.
If the payer differs from the customer, a written authority is required.
Mandatory where the payer is not the registered customer.
Total receivable across all open invoices.
Amount past the due date; drives order blocking.
NO MANUAL ENTRY. Contact and mobile pulled from the points-of-contact block of the customer record; the receipt is sent there on issue.
Where the customer operates project-wise accounts.

fields.field: Number of collection modes used in this receipt
fields.validation: Default 1. SPLIT PAYMENT IS ALLOWED - a single receipt may be collected partly in cash, partly by cheque and partly by IBFT. Enter one tender line below for each mode used.
REPEATING BLOCK - one complete row set per collection mode used. Example: line 1 cash PKR 2,500,000 and line 2 IBFT PKR 2,500,000 against a receipt of PKR 5,000,000.

fields.field: Collection mode for this line (GATING FIELD)
fields.validation: CASH COLLECTION / CHEQUE COLLECTION / IBFT or online bank transfer. Only the matching block below is opened and made mandatory for this line.
Must be greater than zero. The sum of all tender lines must equal the total amount received in field 1.5.

fields.field: Enterprise account or cash counter credited for this line
fields.validation: Bank account for cheque and IBFT lines; cash counter or till for cash lines.
Provisional / Realised / Bounced or Failed. Each tender line is realised independently.
NO MANUAL ENTRY. Cashier or sales officer selected from the employee register on sheet 07; the name and designation are pulled from that record.
Head office cash counter / Plant cash counter / Customer premises / Delivery site.

fields.field: CASH - manual cash receipt book serial
fields.validation: Serial of the pre-printed receipt handed over at the time of collection.

fields.field: CASH - deposit slip number & bank deposit date
fields.validation: Evidence of the cash reaching the enterprise bank account.
Collection date plus one working day. DATE FIELD - amber on the due date, red once overdue; overdue deposits are escalated to finance.
Deposited on time / Deposit pending / OVERDUE. This tender line stays provisional until the cash is banked.
Number printed on the instrument; also covers pay orders and demand drafts.
Date written on the instrument.
Must equal the amount of this tender line.
Bank on which the cheque is drawn.
If Yes, the instrument is held and presented on the due date below.
DATE FIELD - amber 3 days before, red once passed without presentation.
Location and custodian of the instrument, controlled under the cheque register.
Date the instrument was deposited for clearing.
In clearing / Cleared / Returned unpaid, with the date. This line stays provisional until cleared.
Mandatory where the cheque bounced; charges are debited to the customer account.
Source account from which the funds were transferred.
Reference quoted on the bank statement; used to trace the credit.
As shown on the customer's transfer confirmation.

fields.field: IBFT - amount credited per bank statement (PKR)
fields.validation: Actual credit received; a variance against this tender line is flagged for investigation.
Identified and matched to customer / Unidentified credit held in suspense. Unidentified credits are not allocated to invoices.
Pass only when every mandatory field of the mode selected for this line is complete.
Sum of the amounts of every tender line entered above.
MUST BE ZERO. The receipt cannot be issued while the tender lines do not add up to the total amount received.
REPEATING BLOCK - one line per invoice settled by this receipt.
Open invoice from sheet 11; mandatory for receipts against invoices.
Pulled from the invoice.

fields.field: Amount already received against the invoice
fields.validation: Prior receipts allocated to the same invoice.
Invoice value less prior receipts and credit notes.
Cannot exceed the outstanding balance of the invoice. Allocation is made invoice by invoice on these lines; any amount received in excess of the allocations is held as a customer advance.
Tax the customer deducted; must be supported by a CPR or certificate.
Credit note reference applied against this invoice.
Updates the invoice to Paid or Partially paid on realisation.

fields.field: Withholding tax deducted by customer - section
fields.validation: Section under which the customer withheld tax on the payment.
Rate applied by the customer; must match the enterprise's filer status.
Total tax deducted across all allocated invoices.
FBR payment receipt evidencing the deposit by the customer.
Certificate must be obtained to claim the credit in the annual return.

fields.field: CPR verified on the FBR portal
fields.validation: Verification that the tax was actually deposited against the enterprise NTN.
Action taken where the customer deducted without a valid certificate.

Provisional / Realised / Bounced / Under clearing. The receipt is provisional until the funds clear, and is Realised only when EVERY tender line in Section 3 is realised - if any line bounces or a cash deposit is outstanding the receipt stays provisional. On realisation the referenced invoices are set to Paid or Partially paid.
Value date on which the funds were confirmed in the enterprise account.
Mandatory where the instrument was returned unpaid or the receipt is reversed: the reason and the reversal entry reference. Any bounce charges are billed to the customer separately.
Updated receivable balance after this receipt; feeds the customer ageing and statement of account.
Journal voucher debiting bank and crediting the customer account.
Unreconciled / Reconciled / Exception - matched against the bank statement.
